items.text: All four round-001 decisions (D1–D4) selected option A and were folded into plan.md as commitments. D1 expands scope to include the missing `POST /api/v1/references/{id}/validate` handler; spec.json acceptance_allow widened to `scenarios/development-toolchain-validator/{cli,api}/**` to match. D2 adopts subcommand-style reports. D3 adopts nested expectation groups. D4 keeps `validate` synchronous-only for v1 — no history, no async.

Added an explicit `Greenfield: yes` declaration in §1 to address the round-001 plan-validation warning. The new CLI command groups, the validation HTTP handler, and the route registration are all net-new code; no compat shims, deprecation aliases, or unused-var renames are permitted (also called out in §12 Non-goals).

Phase 0 (workshop) was removed from §7 since decisions are resolved. Phase 3 is no longer blocked: it now both adds the validation API handler/test and the CLI `validate` command in the same phase. §11 marks the validation-handler risk as resolved by D1 and adds a new low-likelihood risk that the handler accidentally accumulates business logic — mitigated by the §12 prohibition on adding domain logic to the handler.

Definition of Done in §13 was tightened to drop conditional language (no more 'if D1 expands scope') and to add explicit checks for the validation route, `--dry-run` forwarding, and the user-driven `vrooli scenario restart` step (per `feedback_no_restart_active_scenario.md` — this plan does not restart the scenario in code).

No remaining gaps. Readiness scored 3/3 across all five dimensions: problem statement is concrete, scope is bounded by acceptance_allow + explicit out-of-scope list, the phased approach is well-grounded in existing patterns (`references/register.go`, `connections/register.go`, `executor.go`), every command and the new handler have automated tests, and risks have explicit mitigations or are marked resolved. Item is ready to queue.

plan_updates: Folded D1–D4 commitments into §8 (Contract Decisions). Widened §4 Scope and acceptance_allow to include `api/**` per D1. Added explicit `Greenfield: yes` declaration in §1 to clear the round-001 validation warning, with a matching prohibition on compat shims in §12. Removed Phase 0; rewrote Phase 3 to cover both the new `api/handlers/validation.go` + `api/main.go` wiring and the CLI `validate` command. Added `api/handlers/validation_test.go` to §9 Testing Plan. Marked the validation-handler risk as resolved in §11 and added a low-likelihood risk about handler scope creep. Tightened §10 Rollout and §13 DoD to drop conditional language and add the user-driven scenario restart step. Also updated spec.json acceptance_allow to match the widened scope.
